g.text: Store Submission Version (UC-01) - part 2 of 2: file staging, persistence and compensation
Entered from part 1: the student is authorised, content is present, and this is
a first submission or a replacement on or before the effective deadline.
submission.state = Late if v.isLate, otherwise Submitted
earlier versions are kept; a previous result becomes stale (proposed D1)
return StorageError: submission not saved, no success shown (BR-07)
return v (version number, timestamp, late status)
